mapper.sql: tv.id, tv.tool_catalog_id, td.id AS legacy_tool_definition_id, tc.tool_code, tc.name, tc.description, tc.handler_type, tc.status AS catalog_status, tv.version_number, tv.status, tv.input_schema_json, tv.output_schema_json, tv.risk_level, tv.requires_confirmation, tv.timeout_ms, tv.max_result_bytes, tv.capabilities_json, tv.published_at, tv.created_at, tv.updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tool_version ( tool_catalog_id, version_number, status, input_schema_json, output_schema_json, risk_level, requires_confirmation, timeout_ms, max_result_bytes, capabilities_json, published_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{toolCatalogId}, #{versionNumber}, #{status}, #{inputSchemaJson}, #{outputSchemaJson}, #{riskLevel}, #{requiresConfirmation}, #{timeoutMs}, #{maxResultBytes}, #{capabilitiesJson}, #{publishedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tool_version tv JOIN tool_catalog tc ON tc.id = tv.tool_catalog_id LEFT JOIN tool_definition td ON td.tool_code = tc.tool_code AND td.tool_version = tv.version_number WHERE tv.tool_catalog_id = #{toolCatalogId} ORDER BY tv.version_number DESC, tv.id DESC
SELECT FROM tool_version tv JOIN tool_catalog tc ON tc.id = tv.tool_catalog_id LEFT JOIN tool_definition td ON td.tool_code = tc.tool_code AND td.tool_version = tv.version_number WHERE tv.id = #{id}

SELECT FROM tool_version tv JOIN tool_catalog tc ON tc.id = tv.tool_catalog_id LEFT JOIN tool_definition td ON td.tool_code = tc.tool_code AND td.tool_version = tv.version_number WHERE tv.tool_catalog_id = #{toolCatalogId} AND tv.status = 'DRAFT' ORDER BY tv.version_number DESC, tv.id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tool_version SET input_schema_json = #{inputSchemaJson}, output_schema_json = #{outputSchemaJson}, risk_level = #{riskLevel}, requires_confirmation = #{requiresConfirmation}, timeout_ms = #{timeoutMs}, max_result_bytes = #{maxResultBytes}, capabilities_json = #{capabilitiesJson}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND tool_catalog_id = #{toolCatalogId} AND status = 'DRAFT'
